page_title: STU 3-1 WOL | Stuttgart v Wolfsburg 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' The referee can't ignore those comments and Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90+3' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Serhou Guirassy and he is replaced by Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
85' Substitution. Jonas Wind leaves the pitch and is replaced by Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg).
83' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Chris Fuhrich.
83' That's the end of the game for Anthony Rouault, who is replaced by Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart).
82' 3 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 3:1.
79' Here is a change. Lovro Majer is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
79' It is time for a substitution. Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is on for Tiago Tomas.
79' The attendance for today's match is 54000.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) coming on for Mattias Svanberg.

78' 2 - 1 Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) runs on to a clever pass from Chris Fuhrich and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
77' Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' 4:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
73' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

70' Close! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
67' 1 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Koen Casteels into the roof of the net.
66' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!
66' The Stuttgart players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
65' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Stuttgart using VAR. This could be interesting!
64' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Stuttgart for a penalty. Play continues.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Yannick Gerhardt.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Pascal Stenzel.
61' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Jamie Leweling is replaced by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart).
60' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) picks up an injury.

59' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 53:47.
56' Wolfsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Koen Casteels blocks Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart)'s effort from the edge of the box.
53' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Now Stuttgart have a corner.
50' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.
48' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45+1' Alexander Nubel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' There's an opportunity for Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
42' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
41' A player from Stuttgart commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
36' The percentage of ball possession is – 55:45.
34' 0 - 1 Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) gets to a rebound just outside the penalty area and unleashes a fabulous low effort that goes in off the right post.
33' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
33' Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Nubel, who smothers the ball.
28' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
25' A goal, which was scored by Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart), was disallowed due to offside.
23' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
21' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball in, but Koen Casteels comfortably gathers the ball.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

19' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) produces a good strike that sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

17' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Koen Casteels keeps it out.
16' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
14' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
14' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
11' The ball is out of play. Stuttgart win a corner kick.
10' Referee Daniel Siebert sees the trip by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
9' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
3' The Wolfsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
1' The first half has started.
Daniel Siebert will supervise the game today.
